metadata.title: सिकल सेल: खामोशी से आदिवासी को निगल जाएगी | Sickle Cell Mission in Tribal Areas Exposed
metadata.description:
The Central Government has launched a mission to eradicate Sickle Cell Disease from tribal areas by 2047, claiming that mass screening and awareness drives are being conducted in Adivasi regions.

But when the Main Bhi Bharat team travelled to the tribal belts of Madhya Pradesh, we found a completely different reality. Our ground investigation reveals:

No mass screening of tribal communities

No effective awareness campaigns about sickle cell disease

Tribals left to battle the disease without support

This exclusive ground report uncovers the gap between government claims and the lived reality of Adivasi communities.

📌 Watch how official promises fail to reach those who need them most.

#SickleCell #TribalHealth #MainBhiBharat #GroundReport
